fields.statement: At 044b9e9 ran go test ./internal/api -run TestOpenSessionPane -v -count=1: PASS. Its 'anchor gone splits another pane' case has the fake rex fail the anchor split with 'block block:b1 not found' and asserts the exact rex calls [block call size, split -b block:b1, block ls -w window:w1 --json, block call size of b9, split -b block:b9], which has no window new, and the result is block:b2 in window:w1. The 'anchor gone, no other pane' case fails the session and also opens no window. Read the diff: openSessionPane now calls livePane (rex block ls) and splitPane on a not-found error, and no longer falls through to rexWindowArgs. Checked against the real rex: rex block ls -s <session> --json returns blocks[].block_id, the shape livePane parses. make check exited 0.
